title: One-way ticket to Mars
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Would you accept a one-way ticket to Mars if you knew you could never return?
What personal qualities would someone need to survive such a mission?
Would leaving Earth forever be an act of courage, ambition, or irresponsibility?
Should governments spend large amounts of public money on permanent human settlement on Mars?
What would you miss most about Earth if you lived on Mars?
